Subject: NOON – Key Account Manager | Paula De Francisco

Hi Mubaraka,

I'd like to apply for the Key Account Manager – Noon role from your post. My CV is attached.

How my experience lines up with the brief:

- Noon and UAE marketplaces: I'm based in Dubai and manage DoFreeze's food brands (Befit, Eurocake, Flair) on Noon, talabat and Careem from the brand side: listings, pricing and promotions. Our Befit × Noon "New Year, New Me" campaign added 4,176 incremental units, 31% over baseline.
- GMV ownership: at Alibaba's Miravia marketplace I managed 42 brand accounts and grew GMV 30% quarter on quarter. I also owned the Flash Sales channel against P&L targets, reporting to the CEO.
- Inventory: every week I check, dark store by dark store, whether each platform's purchase orders cover demand, so we catch stock-outs before they happen.
- Food and non-food: food at DoFreeze, Mondelez and Glovo; beauty, fragrances and fashion at Miravia.

To be upfront, my marketplace experience is on Noon rather than Amazon, which is why I'm applying for the Noon opening.

I'd be glad to talk whenever suits you.

Best regards,
Paula De Francisco
